messages.title: PIJ · Thu 26 Nov
messages.body:
• Nasdaq 100 dips into bear territory intraday, recovers to close at 26,047
• US proposes new tariffs on 14 partners as hot inflation lifts December Fed hike odds
• United draw 2-2 at Sporting as Lammens error and Tielemans red mar Pochettino's second game
